description: Defines the ResourceManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management, including methods for setting AV blocking, retrieving blocked applications, and reserving TTS resources.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management, including methods for AV blocking, application blocking status, and TTS resource reservation.
